versions.riskforge: RiskForge v2.1.0 | Apache 2.0 | Zero telemetry | aiexponent.com

steps.name: init
argv: Credit scoring of retail consumer credit applicants: a binary classifier, trained on the UCI Statlog German Credit data, scores each applicant as good or bad credit risk, and a lender's credit officer uses the score when deciding on the application.

steps.name: mitigate-1
argv: Remove attributes 9 (personal status and sex), 13 (age) and 20 (foreign worker) from the model inputs. Keep them in a separate table used only for bias testing.
Mara Lindqvist, Head of Model Risk

steps.name: mitigate-2
argv: Measure the association of each remaining input with sex, age band and foreign worker status on the 1000 records, and drop or bin any input with Cramer's V above 0.3.
Mara Lindqvist, Head of Model Risk

steps.name: mitigate-3
argv: Report record counts and the share of bad class by the sex part of attribute 9, by age band (under 25, 25 to 59, 60 and over) and by foreign worker flag, and state that married and divorced women share one code.
Mara Lindqvist, Head of Model Risk

steps.name: mitigate-4
argv: Compute demographic parity difference and equal opportunity difference by sex, age band and foreign worker flag on the hold-out set; block release if any difference is above 0.10.
Mara Lindqvist, Head of Model Risk

steps.name: mitigate-5
argv: Apply the release gate on demographic parity and equal opportunity difference (above 0.10 blocks release) by sex, age band and foreign worker flag.
Mara Lindqvist, Head of Model Risk

steps.name: mitigate-6
argv: Report accuracy, precision, recall, calibration error and cost under the dataset's cost matrix (5 for a bad applicant scored good, 1 for the reverse) per subgroup on the hold-out set.
Mara Lindqvist, Head of Model Risk

steps.name: mitigate-7
argv: Before release, test on a recent sample of the lender's own applicants with amounts converted from DM to euro, plus edge cases (extreme amount and duration) and small input perturbations; the cost-weighted error must not exceed the hold-out value by more than 10 percent.
Mara Lindqvist, Head of Model Risk

steps.name: mitigate-8
argv: Retrain on recent applicant data from the lender before release, and do not put the model trained only on the 1994 records into production.
Mara Lindqvist, Head of Model Risk

steps.name: mitigate-9
argv: Compute the population stability index of every input and of the score each month; above 0.25 the lender is alerted and the model is reviewed within 30 days.
Mara Lindqvist, Head of Model Risk

steps.name: mitigate-10
argv: Track approval rate, observed bad rate at 12 months and cost-weighted error each month against the validation values, with an alert at a 20 percent relative change.
Mara Lindqvist, Head of Model Risk

steps.name: mitigate-11
argv: Report error rates and cost-weighted error by age band (under 25, 25 to 59, 60 and over) at each release and block release if a band is worse than the overall rate by more than 10 percent.
Mara Lindqvist, Head of Model Risk

steps.name: mitigate-12
argv: Record the legal basis for using the 1994 records and live applicant data, agreed with the lender's data protection officer, and list the personal data each input carries.
Mara Lindqvist, Head of Model Risk

steps.name: mitigate-13
argv: Remove attribute 19 (telephone) as well as attributes 9, 13 and 20 from the model inputs, and document why each remaining input is needed.
Mara Lindqvist, Head of Model Risk

steps.name: mitigate-14
argv: Return the four inputs that contributed most to each score as reason codes, for the lender to pass to the applicant on request.
Mara Lindqvist, Head of Model Risk

steps.name: mitigate-15
argv: Return the four inputs that contributed most to each score as reason codes, for the lender to pass to the applicant on request.
Mara Lindqvist, Head of Model Risk

steps.name: mitigate-16
argv: Show the credit officer the reason codes and the score band next to each score.
Mara Lindqvist, Head of Model Risk

steps.name: mitigate-17
argv: State in the instructions for use that a refused applicant can ask for a second review by a credit officer who did not make the first decision, and that the score alone must not refuse an application.
Mara Lindqvist, Head of Model Risk

steps.name: mitigate-18
argv: Add a limitations section to the instructions for use: the training data is from 1994 and in DM, the collection and the meaning of good and bad are not documented, representativeness is unknown, and code A47 is uncertain.
Mara Lindqvist, Head of Model Risk

steps.name: accept-1
argv: The creator, DOI, licence and file dates are recorded, but when, where and from whom the 1994 records were collected is not published and cannot be recovered. The gap is stated in the limitations section, and the model is retrained on recent lender data before release, so the remaining provenance gap is accepted.
Mara Lindqvist, Head of Model Risk
